checks.pass_criteria: The result carries regenStatus/regenStatusBasis and freshness. With a deliberately broken Feature Studio commit in a throwaway document, the Part Studio read must NOT read as healthy freshness: freshness.mayPrecedeFailedCommitElsewhere is true and freshness.compileVerdictTool names browser_get_fs_compile_status; with the Feature Studio tab active that tool reports compiled:false plus the error text.
checks.if_it_fails: the cross-element blind spot is still silent; fix before treating #14 as closed.

checks.pass_criteria: The call returns an isError tool result (confirm_mutation gate). The MCP child SURVIVES: a following browser_session(action='health') and mcp_tool_catalog both answer. This is expected to pass on the deployed revision too, because 08ae283 (2026-09-25, ancestor of the deployed 6ceacfb) already wraps handlers in try/except.
checks.if_it_fails: the child died on a client input error; capture serve()/stdin-EOF evidence and reopen as a robustness defect.

checks.pass_criteria: With a Part Studio tab active (no Feature Studio editor on screen), browser_read_featurescript returns read=false with the editor-resolution reason (editorCount/visibleEditors) instead of an empty source, and browser_deploy_featurescript refuses with that reason plus editor evidence instead of reporting a successful write. On the Feature Studio tab, read returns sha256 and exactly one visible editor.
checks.if_it_fails: the visible-editor resolution needs the real DOM's geometry rule (a hidden tab may still report a non-zero rect); re-derive the visibility test from that measurement.

checks.pass_criteria: The patched source is what gets written and committed; the result carries preSha256, postSha256 and patchApplied with the touched 1-based lines. An anchor that appears twice refuses with matches/candidateLines and writes nothing. A patch without expect_pre_sha256 is refused before the browser is touched. verbosity='terse' drops notices and keeps the counts.
checks.if_it_fails: check whether the live Onshape editor normalises line endings before hashing (sha256 is over the exact string, so a CRLF difference would show up as a pre-hash mismatch -- that would be a finding, not a bug in the patch engine).

checks.pass_criteria: On a throwaway document: triggered/created true, a new tab whose name is not one of the previous ones, and clickedItem containing '创建 Variable Studio'. browser_delete_element then removes that element and verifies the tab disappears.

how_to_run: Wait for the Windows host to be reachable again (bridge control status answers, a resident browser holds the MCP profile).
Run the checks from a development MCP instance against a throwaway document; never reconfigure the deployed server from here (Operator action).
Record each result in this file (status -> verified/failed, with the tool output) and update the issue comments.
Any check that fails becomes the next code change; a check that passes closes its issue's remaining live item.
